# Singhania Refrigeration

> Cold storage and industrial refrigeration company based in Okhla, New Delhi, offering turnkey cold room, CA/MA store, ammonia and Freon refrigeration plant design, manufacturing, installation and AMC support across Delhi NCR and pan-India.

Singhania Refrigeration designs, manufactures, installs and maintains cold rooms, controlled-atmosphere (CA/MA) stores, ammonia and Freon refrigeration plants, IQF systems, compressor racks, PUF panels, dock shelters and transport refrigeration for food processing, pharmaceutical, dairy, agri-export and logistics businesses. The company draws on 25 years of cold chain and logistics experience through the Singhania Group.

## Products

- [Truck AC](https://singhaniarefrigeration.com/truck-ac-installation-india): Truck AC and transport refrigeration units for dairy, pharma, frozen food, meat and seafood transport.
- [Refrigerated Truck Body & Container](https://singhaniarefrigeration.com/truck-refrigerator-container-manufacturer-in-india): PUF-insulated, temperature-controlled truck bodies and reefer containers for cold chain transport.
- [Cold Storage Refrigeration Units](https://singhaniarefrigeration.com/cold-storage-refrigeration-units-manufacturer-in-india): Energy-efficient refrigeration systems for warehouses and cold rooms storing dairy, produce, frozen food and pharma.
- [Compressor Rack System](https://singhaniarefrigeration.com/compressor-rack-system-manufacturer-in-india): Compressor rack systems for supermarkets, food processing plants, cold storage warehouses and industrial facilities.
- [Ammonia Refrigeration Units](https://singhaniarefrigeration.com/ammonia-refrigeration-units-manufacturer-in-india): Ammonia (NH3) refrigeration units for large-tonnage industrial cooling — cold storage, food processing, blast freezing and ice plants.
- [Freon Refrigeration Units](https://singhaniarefrigeration.com/freon-refrigeration-in-india): Freon (HFC/HFO) refrigeration units for cold rooms, ripening chambers, compressor racks and walk-in freezers.
- [Ripening Systems](https://singhaniarefrigeration.com/ripening-systems-manufacturer-in-india): Ripening chambers for bananas, mangoes and other climacteric fruits with precision temperature, humidity and ethylene control.
- [Multideck Cabinet](https://singhaniarefrigeration.com/multideck-cabinet-manufacturer-in-india): Multideck display cabinets for supermarkets, convenience stores and food retail.
- [IQF Systems](https://singhaniarefrigeration.com/iqf-system-manufacturer-in-india): Individual Quick Freezing systems for vegetables, fruits, seafood, poultry and ready-to-cook foods.
- [Doors & CA Doors](https://singhaniarefrigeration.com/cold-storage-doors-manufacturer-in-india): Insulated cold room and CA doors with precision sealing and heated frames.
- [PUF Panels](https://singhaniarefrigeration.com/puf-panels-manufacturer-in-india): PUF insulated sandwich panels for cold rooms, warehouses and industrial cold storage.
- [Dock Shelter & Dock Leveler](https://singhaniarefrigeration.com/dock-shelter-dock-leveler-manufacturer-in-india): Dock shelters and dock levelers for cold chain warehouses.
- [Heavy Duty Racks](https://singhaniarefrigeration.com/heavy-duty-racks-manufacturer-in-india): Heavy-duty pallet racking systems for warehouses and cold storage.

## Cold Storage Solutions

- [Turnkey Solution](https://singhaniarefrigeration.com/turnkey-cold-storage-solutions-in-india): End-to-end turnkey cold storage projects — design, PUF construction, refrigeration, racking and commissioning under one contract.
- [Segment-Wise Solutions](https://singhaniarefrigeration.com/segment-wise-cold-storage-solutions-in-india): Cold chain solutions matched by industry — dairy, pharma, seafood, fruits and vegetables, QSR and e-commerce.
- [CA Store & Cold Chain Refrigeration](https://singhaniarefrigeration.com/cold-chain-refrigeration-ca-store-freon-ammonia-in-india): Controlled atmosphere (CA) stores, frozen rooms and Freon or ammonia refrigeration plants.
- [Quality Monitoring Solution](https://singhaniarefrigeration.com/cold-chain-quality-monitoring-solution-in-india): Real-time temperature and humidity monitoring with alerts, data logs and compliance reports.
- [Warehouse Management System](https://singhaniarefrigeration.com/warehouse-management-solutions-in-india): WMS for cold storage — pallet tracking, FIFO/FEFO control, billing and inventory visibility across chambers.
- [Transport Management System](https://singhaniarefrigeration.com/transport-management-solutions-in-india): TMS for cold chain fleets — trip planning, live vehicle tracking, temperature visibility and delivery proof.
- [Transport Refrigeration](https://singhaniarefrigeration.com/transport-refrigeration-solutions-in-india): Reefer units, insulated bodies and AMC support for trucks and last-mile vans.
